introHtml: Choosing custom made in USA markers means supporting domestic manufacturing while getting reliable, high-quality writing instruments for your team or event. These markers, like the Dri Mark Clip Cap Highlighter, are built for everyday use in offices, warehouses, and schools. With options for vibrant highlighters or dry erase markers, you can imprint your logo and message with confidence. Perfect for safety managers needing durable tools or marketing directors seeking made-in-USA promotional products that align with company values.
